purpose: Store which documented Hanja sense is intended in a particular name without erasing other senses.

fields.hanja: Actual Hanja character used in the given name.
fields.reading: Actual name reading; semantic lookup key is (hanja, reading).
fields.all_sense_ids: All documented sense IDs for this Hanja+reading.
fields.selected_sense_ids: One or more documented sense IDs chosen as the naming intention.
fields.naming_intent: Plain-language intention for why the selected sense was chosen. Null when unknown.

semantic_risk.other_sense_notice_required: Whether non-selected senses should be shown prominently.
semantic_risk.auto_reject_character: Normally false; only invalid evidence/readings block a recommendation.

interpretation.text: Natural-language naming explanation derived from selected documented senses.

principles: Selecting a sense does not change the dictionary meaning of the character.
Other documented senses remain attached to the character.
A negative or awkward non-selected sense is a notice, not an automatic rejection.
A selected sense must belong to the exact Hanja+reading relation.
Traditional stroke/phonetic/resource calculations remain separate from selected semantic intention.
